summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 reporting a routine monthly cash dividend of $0.12 per common share for September 2026, payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record as of the close of business September 28, 2026, with the same ex-dividend date, alongside preliminary financial data as of August 31, 2026 covering book value, investment portfolio, liquidity, repurchase agreements and leverage. No board recommendation, advisor, acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private or restructuring event is disclosed. GARP.
